pages.text: If you beat a mob to death with a mending book, the act of violence will warp the book itself, turning the enchantment into blood mending. If an item with this enchantment drops beneath 2/3 durability, it will consume the health of its wielder to repair itself.
This is very useful for items that bound mobs will be using - so long as the mob's health is topped up via its binding, its tool will never break.
